beschreibung: A new spec does a round of shopping between clicking "Load reviews" and checking the spinner, and expects the spinner to still be up. The reviews answer after 80-340 ms, so the loading window sometimes closes before the check gets there.
begruendung: test-only change: the new spec checks a loading state after a detour whose length lands in the same range as the 80-340 ms the reviews take, so whether the window is still open when the check arrives decides the outcome
